etfs.title: Latest US session: broad gains in secondary close recap

description.text: AP reported Friday October 9 closes: S&P 500 +0.6% to 7,811.54, Dow +0.8% to 51,654.95, Nasdaq +0.6% to 27,366.17 and Russell 2000 +0.5% to 2,806.98. AP also reported Brent at US$104.72 (+0.4%) and the 10-year Treasury yield at 5.24% versus 5.22%. These are attributed to AP and were not independently matched to primary exchange/market feeds.

sources.label: US indexes, oil and Treasury yields at Friday close
sources.limitation: Secondary reporting; index, commodity and yield values are attributed to AP, not an exchange/provider feed.

items.title: Reported rally does not settle the next-session direction

paragraphs.text: Bull evidence: all four major US indexes rose in AP’s recap. Bear evidence: energy prices and yields remained elevated in that same report, while Michigan current-conditions and inflation-expectation readings were adverse. The joint observations do not prove the catalysts caused index moves. Trigger: verified Monday October 12 regular-session close and subsequent official inflation data. Forecast direction remains Unrated.

description.text: Coverage names required for this report: AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, TSLA, AMZN, META, GOOGL and JPM. A bounded issuer-source review is not proof that no other news exists.

items.title: AAPL — quarter results remain the last verified earnings evidence

paragraphs.text: Apple’s July 30 release reported June-quarter revenue of US$109.4 billion, up 16% year over year, and noted a favorable tariff-refund impact on gross margin and EPS. No newer dated Apple primary filing or release was verified in this bounded review. This is background, not a new October catalyst.

items.title: MSFT and NVDA — new product context; earnings ahead

paragraphs.text: Microsoft’s October 7 announcement described Windows hybrid-intelligence features and named NVIDIA in the device ecosystem; Microsoft scheduled FY2027 Q1 results for October 28 after market close. NVIDIA separately announced October 8 commitments valued at US$1 billion for US science over five years. These are company announcements; implications for demand, revenue and either stock’s price are not established.

sources.label: Microsoft announces quarterly earnings release date
NVIDIA commits US$1 billion to advance US science

items.title: TSLA — Q3 deliveries reported; earnings scheduled October 21

paragraphs.text: Tesla’s October 2 release reported production of 464,391 vehicles, deliveries of 486,532 vehicles and energy-storage deployments of 13.7 GWh for Q3. Tesla scheduled Q3 financial results for October 21 after market close and cautioned that deliveries alone do not establish quarterly financial performance.

sources.label: Tesla Third Quarter 2026 Production, Deliveries & Deployments

items.title: AMZN and META — prior filed guidance remains a risk input

paragraphs.text: The latest verified primary quarterly releases reviewed here are Amazon July 30 and Meta July 29. Amazon’s Q3 guidance cited energy, FX, memory supply, customer demand and macro uncertainty; Meta’s Q3 revenue guidance was US$61–64 billion and its capex outlook was US$130–145 billion. No newer dated primary issuer release was verified in this bounded review; the stated guidance is historical and not a price signal.

paragraphs.text: Alphabet investor materials were checked for a fresh dated disclosure; none was verified for this report window. This is a bounded search result, not evidence that no news exists. No ticker-specific forecast follows from the broader AI-demand discussion.
